# Vantage Rock Financial

> Fractional CFO. AI-native financial leadership. 30-minute Finance Systems Review — fit-check. We don't diagnose on the call.

Vantage Rock Financial is a fractional CFO seat, not a chatbot on last month's file. AI-enabled finance is a function that can actually lead — not a dashboard with a prompt box. AI-native financial leadership means a human on the decisions and a system on the rest.

## Locked facts

- The public offer on the homepage is a 30-minute Finance Systems Review. It is a fit-check. We don't diagnose on the call. No plan to take home.
- Three pillars: AI-enabled finance; AI-native financial leadership; fractional CFO.
- Score first (sample only). Then a Review. Diagnostic and the work only after fit, quoted from scope. No list prices.
- Founder: Stavros Christas. You talk to the operator. Engagements are scoped and led at that level.
- Email: info@vantagerockfinancial.com
